```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(tidysdm)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(elevatr)
library(sjnftools)
library(targets)
```

```{r}
l <- list.files("R", full.names = T)
for (f_path in l) {
  source(f_path)
}

crd_covs <- get_covs_for_predict(
  crd_bd,
  tar_read(coha_evt_gp_n_grouped_level),
  tar_read(epsg)
)

plot(crd_covs$elevation)


coha_model <- readRDS("output/coha_nest_model_20250722084404.rds")

crd_covs$canopy_cover <- as.numeric(crd_covs$canopy_cover)

crd_pred <- predict_raster(coha_model, crd_covs, type = "prob")

writeRaster(crd_pred, "output/coha_mod_crd_20250722.tif")

plot(crd_pred)
```
